name: Alert Dialog
description: A confirmation dialog built on Base UI's accessible AlertDialog primitive. Every variation uses a different entrance technique — scale, blur focus-in, spring overshoot, iOS zoom, CRT unroll, a parting curtain, or an action-reactive exit that branches on Agree vs Disagree. All are theme-token driven so they flip cleanly between light and dark, and every surface is responsive with type that scales up on larger screens.

variations.name: scale
variations.previewHint: Click the trigger to open. The popup scales up from 95% while fading in; adjust the duration with the DialKit panel.
features: Fully theme-token driven (popover / border / primary / muted) — flips cleanly between light and dark
Responsive: full-width on mobile with column-stacked buttons, capped at max-w-md with a right-aligned row on ≥sm
Title steps up from text-base to text-lg on ≥sm screens
Backdrop cross-fades independently of the popup so the character stays on the card
Focus-visible ring on the trigger and full keyboard/ARIA semantics from Base UI's AlertDialog

variations.name: blur
variations.previewHint: Click the trigger to open. The card resolves out of a 16px blur while fading in — like a lens pulling focus.
features: Filter-blur entrance: the popup animates from blur(16px) + opacity 0 to sharp
Glass surface tuned for both themes — a soft white frost on light, a light frost on dark via dark: overrides
Two ambient color blobs sit behind the glass for depth without touching content contrast
Responsive padding and column-stacked buttons on mobile
Base UI AlertDialog handles focus trapping, Escape, and ARIA wiring

variations.name: slam
variations.previewHint: Click the trigger to open. The card drops in with a back-out spring, overshooting before it settles.
features: Neo-brutalist look with a back-out (overshoot) cubic-bezier so the card bounces to rest
Hard offset shadows and borders drawn with var(--foreground) — the whole block inverts correctly in dark mode
Popup fades while an inner wrapper carries the transform via group-data starting/ending styles
Bold accent buttons (yellow / lime) with active press-down offset that reads on both themes
Title scales from text-lg to text-xl on ≥sm screens

variations.name: ios
variations.previewHint: Click the trigger to open. The card enters at 118% and springs down to rest, iOS system-alert style.
features: System-alert zoom: enters at scale 1.18 and springs to rest with a back-out curve, exits shrunk to 0.92
Frosted popover surface and stacked full-width buttons use theme tokens — reads on light and dark
Fixed 270px width with hairline dividers, matching the native iOS alert footprint
Blue action text and active-press background tint
Base UI AlertDialog supplies focus management and Escape-to-dismiss

variations.name: terminal
variations.previewHint: Click the trigger to open. The popup unrolls vertically from a center line, CRT power-on style.
features: Clip-path unroll: opens from inset(50% 0 50% 0) to full, so the screen powers on from a horizontal line
Self-contained green-on-black 'screen' identity stays constant across site themes; the trigger uses theme tokens
Monospace type, faux window chrome dots, and a blinking cursor caret
Opacity ramps at ~40% of the clip duration so the reveal reads as light warming up
Base UI AlertDialog keeps it fully accessible despite the terminal styling

Paper flips to ink in dark mode — card / border / foreground tokens do the work
Title scales from text-xl to text-2xl on ≥sm screens
Base UI AlertDialog provides focus trapping and keyboard semantics

variations.name: reactive
variations.previewHint: Click the trigger to open, then choose. Agree exits with a snappy scale-down; Disagree tips from its top-left corner and tumbles away.
features: Action-aware exit: the closing animation branches on which button was pressed
Agree mirrors the entry — a snappy scale-and-fade on an ease-out curve
Disagree pivots from transform-origin top-left, rotating and dropping on an ease-in 'gravity' curve before fading
Controlled Base UI AlertDialog with a two-layer popup so the exit transform never fights the centering translate
Theme-token driven and honors prefers-reduced-motion — both exits become instant
